title: Daily Work Routine
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ya puedes describir tu rutina laboral diaria paso a paso en inglés usando el Presente Simple.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Rutina Diaria de Trabajo

parts.visual: Usamos el Presente Simple para hablar de hábitos y rutinas: I start work at 9 AM (Empiezo a trabajar a las 9 AM). I have lunch at 1 PM (Almuerzo a la 1 PM).
parts.audio: We use the Simple Present for habits and routines: I start work at 9 AM. I have lunch at 1 PM.

parts.visual: Expresiones de frecuencia: Always (siempre), usually (normalmente), often (frecuentemente), sometimes (a veces), never (nunca). I usually check my emails first (Normalmente reviso mis correos primero).
parts.audio: Frequency expressions: always, usually, often, sometimes, never. I usually check my emails first.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra o frase correcta para describir una rutina laboral.

questions.question: I ____ attend the team meeting on Mondays (normalmente).
I ____ go to the gym before work (a veces).
I ____ a coffee break at 10 AM (me tomo).
questions.explanation: Take a break = tomar un descanso.

questions.question: I ____ my reports in the afternoon (completo).
I ____ from home on Fridays (trabajo).
questions.explanation: Work from home = trabajar desde casa.

questions.question: I ____ lunch with my team on Tuesdays (almuerzo).
After lunch, I ____ my task list (reviso/actualizo).
I ____ my manager every morning (le actualizo a).
I ____ my computer at the end of the day (apago).
How ____ do you check your emails? (¿Con qué frecuencia?).
I ____ the daily stand-up at 9:30 (asisto a).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo o la palabra de frecuencia correcta.

questions.question: I ____ a break at 10 AM (Me tomo).
I ____ my computer at the end (Apago).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I start work at nine AM.
options: I start work at nine AM.
She starts work at nine AM.
I start work at eight AM.
I finish work at nine AM.
questions.correct_answer: I start work at nine AM.

questions.question: Listen carefully.

options: I usually check my emails first.

I usually read my emails first.
questions.correct_answer: I usually check my emails first.
